title: After the flag is removed, closed and open internal work orders stay internal
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in Estimate.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 2, for internal customer A, closed.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Click Edit Customer on customer A's page.
  3. Untick the "Internal customer" checkbox.
  4. Click "Remove flag".
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open the work orders list.
  7. Open work order 2.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • "Internal customer" is ticked.

Step 3:

  • The Remove the Internal flag window opens.

Step 4:

  • "Internal customer" is unticked.

Step 5:

  • The Edit Customer window closes.

Step 6:

  • Work order 1 shows the "Internal" badge.
  • Work order 2 shows the status "Closed" with the "Internal" badge.

Step 7:

  • Work order 2 shows the status Closed with the "Internal" badge.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories), story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S1-E1: “If a flagged customer loses the flag, its closed internal work orders stay Closed · Internal and its open internal work orders stay internal, in every list and report; the classification is written on the work order, never read from the customer.”
  • Key Decisions: “The classification is written on the work order, never read live from the customer flag.”
  • S2-R13: “The classification is written on the work order when it is created, when its customer changes and when it is converted; the closed record carries it too, with the category. Lists, reports and integrations read it from there, never from the customer flag. Converting to no charge or to billable, changing the category, a shop supplies amount change, Make internal (S1-R11, on each work order), Close with its posting date, Reopen, and adding or removing a customer's Internal flag are recorded in the work order or customer Audit Log with the user and the time.”
